_about: The Shattered Throne (levels 68-70), the last fight: bulwarks, arcanists, confessors, stalkers, maulers and cantors answer the howl of the rift, the null-ward sentinels and the riftwarden juggernaut are elites, Marshal Kyrell, Choir-Matron Serathis and Shatterblade Veyl are sub-bosses, and the Shattered Emperor tears rifts in the floor, calls his court, and darkens the world as he breaks.
